notes.en: [[character:wriothesley]] as a [[element:stellar-conduct]] DPS uses his enhanced [[ability:na]] and [[ability:ca]] to deal [[element:stellar-conduct]] DMG. In this role, he is played with a character that can **enable the [[element:stellar-glimmer]] reactions** (i.e. [[character:odette]]) so he can fully take advantage of his **Witch's Revelation Passive**.
As he only gets his enhanced [[ability:ca]] when he is under 60% [[stat:hp|HP]], it is strongly discouraged to play [[character:wriothesley]] with a healer.
